I will not apply chemical fertilizer on this beans plot because legumes make their own nitrogen, and I need to save my limited fertilizer for the maize plot where it matters more. I will spread manure from my livestock to keep the soil fertile, and plant improved bean seed that I received from the agricultural extension officer last season. My family and I will do all the work by hand — weeding, planting, and harvesting — because I cannot afford to hire help or buy chemicals, and we rely on the rains since there is no water source nearby for irrigation.
